kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تقتلعون (form VIII)
# تَقْتَلِعُونَ (taqtaliʕūna) /taq.ta.li.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# تُقْتَلَعُونَ (tuqtalaʕūna) /tuq.ta.la.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
